blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in vision foundation models (VFMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across diverse unimodal visual tasks. However, adapting VFMs to referring image segmentation (RIS) typically necessitates precise vision-language alignment via full fine-tuning, incurring substantial computational overhead and risking catastrophic forgetting. While existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods enable safe knowledge transfer with minimal training costs, they predominantly operate independently within individual modalities or focus exclusively on unidirectional guidance from language to vision, overlooking progressive cross-modal interaction and visual feedback for textual refinement. To address these limitations, we propose B idirectional R eciprocal L earning ( BRL ), a novel adapter-based PEFT framework that facilitates hierarchical, bidirectional information flow within both token-mixing and channel-mixing layers of frozen foundation models. Specifically, BRL introduces two complementary lightweight modules. The Reciprocal Attention Adapter (RAA) performs cross-modal query-key exchanges at the token level, enabling visual and linguistic tokens to mutually attend to each other for fine-grained spatial grounding. The Reciprocal Gate Adapter (RGA) generates cross-modal gating signals at the channel level, allowing global semantic context from one modality to adaptively recalibrate channel activations of the other. Extensive experiments on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of BRL over prior RIS methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance while requiring less than 0.5% backbone parameter updates. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/BRL .
blocks.zh: 视觉基础模型(VFMs)的近期进展在各种单式视觉任务中显示出显著的能力。 然而,使VFM适应图像分解(RIS),通常需要通过全面微调进行精确的视觉语言校正,引起大量的计算间接费用,并有可能造成灾难性的遗忘。 虽然现有的参数效率微调(PEFT)方法能够以最低的培训费用进行安全的知识转让,但它们主要在个别模式内独立运作,或者只注重从语言到愿景的单向指导,忽略了渐进式的跨模式互动和可视化反馈,以进行文字改进。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议B idiform R ecopical L winding(BRL),这是一种基于新颖适配器的PEFT框架,它有利于在符号混合和信道混合的冻结基模型层内分级,双向的信息流动. 具体而言,BRL引入了两个互补的轻量级模块. 对等注意适配器(RAA)在标语一级进行跨模式的查询键交换,使视觉和语言的标语能够互相关注,进行精细的空间定位. 对流门适配器(RGA)在通道一级生成跨模式的吉卜赛信号,使全球语义上下文从一种模式到适应性地调整通道激活另一种模式. 对RefCOCOCO、RefCOCO+和RefCOCOg基准的广泛实验表明,BRL优于以前的RIS方法,实现了最先进的性能,同时需要更新不到0.5%的骨干参数。 守则和模型将在https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/BRL上发布。 。 。 。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Referring image segmentation (RIS) aims to segment the specific visual object corresponding to a free-form textual expression [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . As a foundational dense prediction task bridging vision and language, RIS brings crucial effects in human-computer interaction [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] , assisted diagnosis [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] , and disaster assessment [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] . In contrast to traditional image segmentation [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] , which learns mappings to a set of semantic categories [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] , RIS requires establishing precise contextual relationships between visual and linguistic cues. To achieve it, pioneering works follow a two-stage paradigm that identifies the most relevant proposal according to its similarity with the expression [ 22 , 23 ] , whereas later studies have shifted toward a one-stage paradigm that enables end-to-end comprehension via multimodal feature fusion and interaction [ 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 ] .
blocks.zh: 参考图像分解(RIS)旨在分解与自由式文字表达对应的特定视觉对象[1,2,3]. 作为一个基础性密集的预测任务连接设想和语言,RIS在人与计算机的相互作用[4、5、6、7]、辅助诊断[8、9、10]和灾害评估[11、12、13]方面带来关键的影响。 与传统的图像分割[14,15,16,17]不同,它学习了一组语义分类[18,19,20,21]的映射,RIS要求在视觉和语言提示之间建立精确的上下文关系. 为实现这一目标,开创性作品遵循一个两阶段范式,根据其与[22、23]表述的相似性确定最相关的提议,而后来的研究则转向一个阶段范式,通过多式联运特征聚变和互动,使最终理解[24、25、26、27、28]。

blocks.en: Recent research has increasingly leveraged multimodal large language models (MLLMs) [ 29 , 30 ] to advance RIS by exploiting their pre-aligned semantic spaces for cross-modal reasoning [ 31 , 32 , 33 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Nevertheless, prevailing MLLMs are mainly pretrained via global image-text matching, yielding coarse-grained representations suboptimal for RIS, which demands fine-grained perception and precise localization. In contrast, vision foundation models (VFMs) [ 34 , 35 , 36 ] have achieved remarkable success across diverse visual tasks, driven by their superior capacity for capturing fine-grained structural details. However, adapting these powerful unimodal VFMs to the multimodal RIS scenario presents significant obstacles. Traditional full fine-tuning incurs prohibitive computational overhead, while the discrepancy between unimodal pre-training objectives and multimodal feature alignment often risks catastrophic forgetting and representation interference.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究越来越多地利用多式联运大语言模型[29,30],通过利用它们预先结合的语义空间进行跨模式推理[31,32,33,5,6,7],推进RIS. 尽管如此,普遍存在的MLLM主要通过全球图像文本匹配进行预训,产生粗糙的描述值低于RIS的优化,这需要精细的感知和精确的本地化. 相比之下,视觉基础模型(VFMs)[34,35,36]在各种视觉任务上取得了显著的成功,其驱动力在于其捕捉精细结构细节的优越能力. 然而,使这些强大的单式VFM适应多式联运的RIS方案,是一大障碍。 传统的全面微调会造成令人望而却步的计算间接费用,而单式预训目标与多式联运特征调整之间的差异往往有可能造成灾难性的遗忘和代表干扰。

blocks.en: In response, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has emerged as a promising alternative, seeking to safely condense general knowledge into task-specific expertise while minimizing training costs [ 38 , 39 , 40 ] . Current PEFT methods mainly include reparameterization-based [ 41 , 42 , 43 ] , prompt-based [ 44 , 45 ] , and adapter-based [ 46 , 47 ] tuning. Nevertheless, most of them exhibit critical issues when applied to RIS. As illustrated in Fig. 1 . a , common adapter-based methods [ 48 , 49 ] operate independently within individual modalities, lacking explicit cross-modal interaction. Recent work such as DETRIS [ 37 ] explores the feasibility of VFMs in RIS by constructing a multimodal adapter using global textual information, as depicted in Fig. 1 . b . While effective, it remains constrained by two fundamental limitations. First, the language representation remains static during multimodal interaction, preventing ambiguous expressions from being grounded and refined according to visual evidence. Second, the absence of inter-modality progressive learning may lead to the accumulation of negative effects caused by misaligned representations.
blocks.zh: 作为回应,参数效率微调(PEFT)已成为一种有希望的替代办法,力求将一般知识安全地凝聚成具体任务的专门知识,同时尽量减少培训费用[38、39、40]。 目前的PEFT方法主要包括基于再参数化的[41,42,43],基于快速的[44,45],以及基于适配器的[46,47]调制. 然而,其中大多数在适用于RIS时都显示出关键问题。 如图1所示,一种基于通用适配器的方法[48、49]在个别模式内独立运作,缺乏明确的跨模式互动。 最近的工作,如DETRIS[37],探索了VFM在RIS的可行性,方法是利用全球文本信息建造一个多式联运适配器,如Fig所描述的. 1,b (中文(简体) ). 它虽然有效,但仍受到两个基本限制的限制。 第一,在多式联运互动期间,语言表述仍然静止不变,无法根据视觉证据确定和完善模棱两可的表述。 第二,缺乏模式间渐进式学习可能导致因表述不一致而导致的消极影响累积。

blocks.en: Considering the current progress and the above two shortcomings, a natural question arises: can we unleash the full potential of VFMs in multimodal dense predictions? We answer it affirmatively with our proposed Bidirectional Reciprocal Learning (BRL) framework, a lightweight yet efficient adapter-based tuning method that enables vision-language interaction bidirectionally and hierarchically. As shown in Fig. 1 . c , BRL consists of two core components: the Reciprocal Attention Adapter (RAA), which facilitates token-wise mutual reasoning for dense cross-modal alignment, and the Reciprocal Gate Adapter (RGA), which realizes channel-wise reciprocal regulation to balance modality contributions and suppress irrelevant signals. Specifically, RAA introduces a reciprocal attention mechanism in the self-attention layer, which leverages linguistic queries to guide the localization of visual tokens while simultaneously feeding visual evidence back to refine textual semantics. This mutual refinement builds second-order dependencies between modalities, allowing visual grounding and linguistic semantics to evolve jointly rather than relying on static language priors. In contrast, RGA operates on the feed-forward layer by establishing a reciprocal gating mechanism that dynamically adjusts activation strengths based on cross-modal global prior information. This gated regulation mitigates cross-modal representation imbalance, attenuates modality-specific redundancy, and amplifies informative responses, leading to more robust multimodal representations. Notably, RAA and RGA are complementary: the former focuses on spatial correspondence learning, whereas the latter regulates global semantic consistency and feature selectivity.
blocks.zh: 考虑到目前的进展和上述两个缺点,自然会产生一个问题:在多式联运密集预测中,我们能否释放VFM的全部潜力? 我们用我们提议的双向对等学习框架来肯定地回答这个问题。 双向对等学习框架是一种轻量级但高效的适应器调制方法,能够双向和分级地进行视觉语言互动。 如图1c所示,BRL由两个核心部分组成:对等注意适配器(RAA),它有利于对密集的跨模式对齐进行象征性的相互推理;对等门适配器(RGA),它实现对通道的对等调节,以平衡方式贡献和压制无关的信号. 具体地说,RAA在自留心层中引入了对等的注意机制,它利用语言查询来指导视觉符号的本地化,同时反馈视觉证据来完善文字语义. 这种相互完善在模式之间建立了第二顺序的依存关系,使得视觉地基和语言语义能够共同演化,而不是依赖静态语言前传. 相比之下,RGA则通过建立对等的定位机制,在跨模式全球先前信息的基础上动态调整激活优势,从而在向馈层上运作。 这种有限度的监管减轻了跨模式代表的不平衡,减少了特定模式的冗余,扩大了信息化的应对措施,从而形成了更强有力的多式联运代表。 值得注意的是,RAA和RGA是互补的:前者侧重于空间函授学习,而后者则规范全球语义一致性和特征选择性.

blocks.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of our method, we conduct extensive experiments on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg benchmarks. As summarized in Fig. 2 , BRL not only surpasses traditional full fine-tuning methods and recent MLLM-based methods, but also dramatically improves adaptation efficiency by reducing learnable parameters and FLOPs by nearly 100 × \times and 200 × \times under the base and large architectures, respectively. These results demonstrate the remarkable potential of reciprocal multimodal adaptation for efficient dense vision-language understanding. Our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们的方法的有效性,我们对RefCOCO、RefCOCO+和RefCOCOg基准进行了广泛的试验。 如图2概述,BRL不仅超越了传统的全微调方法和最近的基于MLLM的方法,而且通过将可学习参数和FLOP分别减少近100××时和200××时,在基础架构和大型架构下大幅提高适应效率. 这些结果表明,对等的多模式适应具有巨大的潜力,可促进高效密集的视觉语言理解。 我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: 1. We propose BRL, a parameter-efficient learning framework that unleashes the power of vision foundation models in referring image segmentation, allowing progressive mutual vision-language alignment and refinement while updating less than 0.5% parameters. 2. We introduce RAA, a lightweight token-level interaction module that performs reciprocal cross-modal attention within transformer self-attention layers, enabling visual and linguistic tokens to mutually refine each other for fine-grained spatial grounding. 3. We further develop RGA, a channel-level modulation module that dynamically generates cross-modal gating signals to adaptively recalibrate heterogeneous feature responses, thereby suppressing modality-specific redundancy and enhancing semantic consistency.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 我们提出BRL,是一个参数高效的学习框架,它释放了视觉基础模型在指代图像分割时的威力,允许在更新不到0.5%的参数的同时,渐进的相互视觉语言对齐和完善. 2. 我们采用RAA,这是一种轻量级符号级互动模块,在变压器自留心层内进行对等的交叉式注意,使视觉符号和语言符号能够相互改进,用于精细的空间定位。 3. 我们进一步发展RGA,这是一个信道级调制模块,能动态生成跨模式的调制信号,以适应性地调整各种特征反应,从而抑制特定模式的冗余,增强语义一致性。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Referring Image Segmentation
blocks.zh: II-A 参考图像分割

blocks.en: Referring image segmentation (RIS) aims to localize and segment the target region in an image according to a free-form natural language expression [ 50 , 51 , 52 ] . As a representative multimodal dense prediction task, RIS requires simultaneously understanding visual structures and linguistic semantics while establishing fine-grained cross-modal correspondence between them. Early RIS methods mainly follow a two-stage paradigm, where candidate object proposals are first generated and then matched with the referring expression based on multimodal similarity [ 53 , 22 ] . Although effective, such approaches heavily depend on proposal quality and often suffer from limited end-to-end optimization capability.
blocks.zh: 参考图像分解(RIS)旨在按照一种自由形式的自然语言表达[50,51,52]将目标区域定位和分化. 作为一项具有代表性的多式联运密集预测任务,RIS需要同时理解视觉结构和语言语义,同时在它们之间建立精细的跨模式通信. 早期的RIS方法主要遵循两个阶段的范式,即候选对象建议书首先生成,然后与基于多式联运相似性的参考表述相匹配[53,22]. 这些办法虽然有效,但在很大程度上取决于提案的质量,往往受到端到端优化能力有限的影响。

blocks.en: To overcome these limitations, recent studies gradually transition toward one-stage end-to-end frameworks [ 3 , 54 , 55 ] , which directly perform multimodal interaction and dense prediction within unified architectures. Benefiting from transformer-based multimodal reasoning, these methods fuse visual and linguistic tokens through cross-attention mechanisms [ 56 , 26 , 28 ] , significantly improving global contextual understanding and spatial grounding ability. More recently, the emergence of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) [ 29 , 30 ] has further promoted RIS by leveraging large-scale vision-language pretraining and aligned semantic representations [ 5 , 57 , 6 , 7 ] . Despite their impressive performance, most existing MLLM-based methods rely on careful fine-tuning or heavy multimodal instruction tuning, resulting in substantial computational overhead and potential risks of catastrophic forgetting. Moreover, prevailing multimodal pretraining objectives mainly emphasize global image-text alignment, which remains suboptimal for RIS requiring fine-grained spatial localization and dense cross-modal interaction.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,最近的研究逐步过渡到一个阶段的端到端框架[3、54、55],这些框架直接在统一的架构内进行多式联运互动和密集预测。 这些方法从基于变压器的多式联运推理中受益,通过交叉注意机制[56、26、28]将视觉和语言符号连接起来,大大提高了全球背景理解和空间定位能力。 最近,多式联运大语言模型的出现[29,30],通过利用大规模视觉语言预训和语义表达[5, 57, 6, 7],进一步促进了RIS. 尽管这些方法的性能令人印象深刻,但大多数现有的基于MLLM的方法都依赖仔细的微调或重型多模式指令调试,从而导致大量的计算间接费用和潜在的灾难性遗忘风险。 此外,通行的多式联运预培训目标主要强调全球图像文本的对接,对于需要精细空间定位和密集的跨模式互动的RIS来说,这仍然不够理想。

blocks.en: In contrast, recent vision foundation models (VFMs) [ 34 , 35 , 36 ] demonstrate remarkable capability in capturing fine-grained visual structures and dense spatial details, making them highly promising for RIS. However, effectively adapting powerful unimodal VFMs to multimodal dense prediction remains insufficiently explored, especially under parameter-efficient learning paradigms.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,最近的视觉基础模型(VFMs)[34,35,36]在捕捉精细的视觉结构和密集的空间细节方面表现出卓越的能力,使它们对RIS很有希望. 然而,特别是在参数效率高的学习范式下,有效使强大的单式VFM适应多式联运密集预测仍未得到充分探索。

blocks.en: II-B Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: II-B 参数有效微调

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) aims to adapt large pre-trained models to downstream tasks by updating only a small subset of parameters while preserving the majority of pretrained knowledge [ 40 ] . Existing PEFT methods mainly include adapter-based [ 48 , 49 , 47 ] , prompt-based [ 58 , 44 , 45 ] , and reparameterization-based learning [ 41 , 59 , 42 ] . Adapter-based methods insert lightweight bottleneck modules into transformer layers for task-specific adaptation [ 48 ] , whereas prompt-based methods optimize learnable prompts to guide downstream learning [ 58 ] . Reparameterization-based approaches instead approximate weight updates through low-rank decomposition for efficient optimization [ 41 ] . Owing to their strong efficiency and transferability, PEFT techniques have achieved remarkable success in large language models [ 38 ] and vision foundation models [ 39 ] .
blocks.zh: 参数效率微调(PEFT)旨在通过仅更新一小段参数,同时保留大多数预训知识[40],使大型预训模型适应下游任务. 现有的PEFT方法主要包括基于适配器的[48,49,47],基于即时的[58,44,45],以及基于再平衡的学习[41,59,42]. 基于适应器的方法将轻量级瓶颈模块插入变压器层,用于特定任务的适应[48],而基于快速的方法则优化了可学习的提示,以指导下游学习[58]. 基于再平衡的方法转而通过低级分解进行近似重量更新,以高效优化[41]. PEFT技术由于其强大的效率和可转移性,在大型语言模型[38]和视觉基础模型[39]中取得了显著成功.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, applying PEFT to multimodal dense prediction remains highly challenging. Unlike conventional classification or generation tasks, RIS requires fine-grained reciprocal interaction between visual grounding and linguistic semantics throughout the adaptation process. Existing RIS-oriented PEFT methods mainly focus on modality-specific adaptation, such as inserting adapters only into visual encoders or employing lightweight language modules for textual refinement. A few recent works [ 37 , 33 ] further explore multimodal adaptation for RIS by injecting linguistic guidance into visual representations. However, their interactions are typically shallow or unidirectional, where language mainly serves as static semantic supervision for visual modulation. Such asymmetric adaptation prevents multimodal representations from being progressively refined through reciprocal feedback and limits the establishment of hierarchical cross-modal dependencies.
blocks.zh: 然而,将PEFT应用于多式联运密集预测仍然极具挑战性。 与传统的分类或生成任务不同,RIS要求在整个适应过程中视觉地基和语言语义之间的精细的对等相互作用. 现有的RIS面向PEFT的方法主要侧重于特定模式的适应,例如只将适配器插入到视觉编码器中,或者使用轻量级语言模块进行文字改进. 最近几部作品[37,33]通过将语言指导注入视觉表现,进一步探索了RIS的多式联运适应. 然而,它们的相互作用一般是浅或单向的,语言主要起到静态语义监督的作用,用于视觉调制. 这种不对称的适应使多式联运的表示无法通过相互反馈而逐步完善,并限制了建立分级的跨模式依赖关系。

blocks.en: Different from existing PEFT paradigms, our proposed BRL formulates multimodal adaptation as a reciprocal representation learning process. By jointly modeling token-level reciprocal reasoning and channel-level reciprocal regulation, BRL enables progressive bidirectional interaction between frozen vision and language foundation models for efficient and robust referring image segmentation.
blocks.zh: 与现有的PEFT范式不同,我们提议的BRL将多式联运发展成一种相互代表学习过程。 BRL通过联合建模符号级对等推理和通道级对等调节,使得冷冻视觉与语言基础模型之间可以进行渐进的双向交互,以高效和强健的参考图像分割.

Specifically, RAA performs token-level reciprocal interaction via bidirectional attention composition to establish fine-grained cross-modal correspondence, while RGA conducts channel-level reciprocal regulation through cross-modal gated modulation to enhance global semantic consistency and adaptive feature selectivity. Through progressive bidirectional adaptation across selected transformer layers, BRL enables hierarchical reciprocal representation learning between visual grounding and linguistic semantics with minimal trainable parameters.

blocks.en: Through iterative reciprocal adaptation between RAA and RGA across multiple transformer layers, visual and linguistic representations gradually evolve from independent unimodal features toward semantically aligned multimodal representations, thereby facilitating robust dense cross-modal grounding and understanding. Overall, BRL establishes a hierarchical reciprocal adaptation paradigm, where token-level interaction captures fine-grained spatial correspondence, while channel-level regulation enhances global semantic consistency and adaptive feature selectivity.
blocks.zh: 通过RAA和RGA之间跨越多个变压器层的迭代对等适应,视觉和语言表达方式逐渐从独立的单式特征演变为集成式对齐的多式联运表达方式,从而便利了强烈的密集跨式定位和理解. 总体来说,BRL建立了分级对等适应范式,表示符号级交互可以捕捉细纹空间对应,而信道级调控可以增强全球语义一致性和适应性特征选择性.

blocks.en: III-B Reciprocal Token Interaction
blocks.zh: 三-B 对等关系

blocks.en: Existing multimodal PEFT methods mainly adopt unidirectional interaction paradigms, where linguistic representations are treated as static semantic guidance for visual modulation. Although such strategies introduce cross-modal information into visual adaptation, the interaction process remains inherently asymmetric, preventing visual grounding and linguistic semantics from being jointly optimized through reciprocal feedback. Moreover, conventional cross-attention mechanisms mainly establish first-order correspondence between modalities, which is insufficient for RIS requiring fine-grained spatial reasoning and semantic disambiguation.
blocks.zh: 现有多式联运 PEFT方法主要采用单向交互范式,其中语言表达法作为静态语义指导用于视觉调制. 虽然这些战略将跨模式信息引入视觉适应,但互动过程内在的不对称,阻止通过对等反馈共同优化视觉地基和语言语义. 此外,传统的交叉注意机制主要在方式之间确立第一顺序的对应关系,这不足以使RIS需要精细的空间推理和语义解析.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we propose the Reciprocal Attention Adapter (RAA) to perform bidirectional token-level reciprocal interaction within transformer self-attention layers. Different from conventional cross-modal attention that directly aggregates heterogeneous features, RAA explicitly constructs reciprocal second-order dependencies between visual and linguistic representations, enabling each modality to progressively refine itself through the contextual structure of the other modality.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议对等注意适应器(RAA)在变压器自留心层内进行双向符号级对等交互. RAA不同于直接汇总不同特征的常规跨模式关注,它明确构建视觉和语言表述之间的对等的二阶依赖关系,使每种模式都能够通过另一种模式的背景结构逐步完善自身.

blocks.en: III-C Reciprocal Channel Regulation
blocks.zh: 三-C 对等渠道条例

blocks.en: Although token-level reciprocal interaction enables fine-grained spatial correspondence learning, multimodal representations in RIS still suffer from modality imbalance and semantic redundancy. In particular, token-wise interaction mainly focuses on local correspondence reasoning, while lacking explicit regulation over global semantic consistency and feature selectivity across channels. Consequently, irrelevant activations or dominant modality biases may progressively accumulate during deep multimodal adaptation.
blocks.zh: 虽然象征性的对等互动可以进行精细的空间通信学习,但RIS中的多式联运表述仍然受到模式不平衡和语义冗余的影响。 特别是,象征性的互动主要侧重于地方的函证推理,同时缺乏对全球语义一致性的明确规范,并具有跨渠道的选择性。 因此,在深入的多式联运适应过程中,不相关的激活或主导模式的偏差可能会逐渐累积。

blocks.en: To address this issue, we propose the Reciprocal Gate Adapter (RGA) to perform bidirectional channel-level reciprocal regulation within transformer feed-forward layers. Different from existing gating mechanisms that independently recalibrate features within a single modality, RGA dynamically generates cross-modal gating priors from global semantic statistics, allowing each modality to adaptively regulate the channel responses of the other modality.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们提议对等闸机(RGA)在变压器向前进层内进行双向信道级对等调节. 不同于现有的在单一模式内独立重新调整特征的配位机制,RGA动态生成来自全球语义统计的跨模式配位前缀,使每种模式能够适应性地调节另一种模式的信道响应.

blocks.en: IV-A Datasets and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 数据集和评价计量

blocks.en: IV-A 1 Datasets
blocks.zh: IV-A 1 数据集

blocks.en: We conduct experiments on three widely used referring image segmentation benchmarks:
blocks.zh: 我们对三个广泛使用的图像分解基准进行实验:

blocks.en: RefCOCO [ 50 ] : The RefCOCO is a large-scale and widely adopted benchmark for RIS. It contains 19,994 images accompanied by 142,210 referring expressions describing 50,000 objects. All annotations are collected through an interactive two-player game built on the MSCOCO [ 61 ] dataset. The benchmark is split into four partitions: 120,624 samples for training, 10,834 for val, 5,657 for testA, and 5,095 for testB. The expressions are relatively concise, averaging 3.6 words.
blocks.zh: RefCOCO [50]: 参考文件COCO是一个大规模和广泛采用的RIS基准. 它包含19,994张图像,并附有142,210个描述5万物体的引用表达式. 所有注解都通过基于MSCO[61]数据集的交互式双玩家游戏来收集. 基准分为四个分区:120,624个培训样本,10,834个Val样本,5,657个测试A样本,5,095个测试B样本。 表达方式相对简洁,平均为3.6字.

blocks.en: RefCOCO+ [ 50 ] : The RefCOCO+ provides 141,564 referring expressions related to 49,856 objects in 19,992 images. Unlike RefCOCO, it introduces a higher level of difficulty by deliberately removing absolute spatial terms, forcing models to rely more on appearance cues rather than positional hints. Its data split follows the same protocol as RefCOCO, comprising 120,624 training examples, 10,758 in val, 5,726 in testA, and 4,889 in testB.
blocks.zh: 参考COCO+[50]: RefCOCO+在19,992个图像中提供了141,564个与49,856个物体有关的引用表达式. 与RefCOCO不同,它通过故意去除绝对空间术语引入了更高的难度,迫使模型更多地依赖外观提示而不是位置提示. 其数据划分遵循与RefCOCO相同的协议,包括120,624个培训实例、10,758个Val、5,726个测试A和4,889个测试实例。 B类.

blocks.en: RefCOCOg [ 51 , 52 ] : The RefCOCOg comprises 104,560 referring expressions that describe 54,822 objects within 26,711 images. The text annotations are relatively long, with an average length of 8.4 words, providing richer information about object appearances and locations. We follow the commonly used Google [ 51 ] split and UMD [ 52 ] split, which are denoted as RefCOCOg(g) and RefCOCOg(u), respectively.
blocks.zh: [51,52]: RefCOCOg包含104,560个参考表达式,描述26,711个图像中的54,822个物体. 文字说明相对较长,平均长度为8.4字,提供了有关物体外观和位置的丰富信息. 我们遵循常用的Google[51]拆分和UMD[52]拆分,分别表示为RefCOCOg(g)和RefCOCOg(u).

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness and generalization capability of the proposed BRL method, we consider two experimental settings following recent works [ 32 , 37 ] : The common setting evaluates dataset-specific adaptation capability, whereas the mixed setting further examines the robustness of multimodal models under diverse referring expressions and visual scenes.
blocks.zh: 为了全面评估拟议的BRL方法的有效性和概括性能力,我们考虑在近期工作之后的两个实验设置[32、37]: 共同的设置评价数据集的适应能力,而混合设置则在不同的参考表达式和视觉场景下进一步审查多式联运模型的稳健性。

blocks.en: IV-A 2 Metrics
blocks.zh: 4-A 2 度量衡

blocks.en: We employ two commonly used metrics, overall IoU (oIoU) and mean IoU (mIoU), in all experiments to quantify each method. The former computes the ratio between the aggregate intersection area and the aggregate union area across the entire dataset, which inherently favors larger objects. In contrast, the latter calculates the IoU for each sample individually and then averages across all samples, thereby treating objects of different sizes equally.
blocks.zh: 我们在所有实验中都采用了两个常用的度量衡,即整体IoU(oIoU)和指IoU(mIoU),以量化每种方法. 前者计算整个数据集中集合交叉区域与集合结合区域之间的比例,这在本质上有利于较大的对象. 相比之下,后者分别计算每个样本的IOU,然后在所有样本中平均计算,从而平等对待大小不同的物体。

blocks.en: IV-B Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 四-B 执行详情

blocks.en: We mainly use DINOv3 [ 36 ] pretrained ViT-B [ 62 ] (DINOv3-B) with 12 layers and 768 hidden size, and ViT-L [ 62 ] (DINOv3-L) with 24 layers and 1024 hidden size as the vision foundation model, combining the 12-layer language foundation model with hidden size 512 from CLIP-ViT-B [ 29 ] , to evaluate the effectiveness of our method. For all experiments, the network is trained for 50 epochs using the Adam optimizer with a batch size of 32, a learning rate of 0.0001, and a step learning rate decay of 0.1 at epoch 35 on 8 RTX 4090 GPUs. Following previous works [ 60 , 31 , 37 ] , the textual sentence length is set to 17 for RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, RefCOCOg(g), and the mixed dataset, and 22 for RefCOCOg(u). The task decoder has three layers with 8 heads of attention and a feed-forward hidden size of 512. Images are resized to 480 × \times 480 without any data augmentations for training, and no additional post-processing operations are applied during inference. We keep the adapter dimension d = 64 d=64 as a default setting. Our BRL is applied at layers i ∈ [ 5 , 8 , 11 ] i\in[5,8,11] for both DINOv3-B and the text encoder, while at layers i ∈ [ 11 , 17 , 23 ] i\in[11,17,23] for DINOv3-L.
blocks.zh: 我们主要使用DINov3 [36] 预训ViT-B [62] (DINOv3-B) 12层和768个隐藏大小,和ViT-L [62] (DINOv3-L) 24层和1024个隐藏大小作为视野基础模型,将12层语言基础模型与CLIP-ViT-B [29] 的隐藏大小512结合起来,来评价我们的方法的有效性. 对所有实验来说,网络是用亚当优化器对50个纪元进行训练的,批量大小为32,学习率为0.0001,在8 RTX 4090 GPU上的纪元35时,步步学习衰减率为0.1. 在以往的作品[60、31、37]之后,文字句子长度定为17个,适用于RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg(g)和混合数据集,适用于RefCOCOg(u)22个。 任务解码器有3层,8个注意头,饲料向前隐藏大小512. 图像被调整为 480 × \times 480,没有用于培训的任何数据增强,在推论期间没有应用额外的处理后操作. 我们保留适配器维度d=64 d=64作为默认设置. 我们的BRL应用在i → [5, 8, 11] 层中用于DINov3-B和文本编码器,而在i → [11, 17, 23] 层中用于DINov3-L.

blocks.en: IV-C 1 Comparison Under the Common Setting
blocks.zh: IV-C 1 在共同环境下的比较

blocks.en: Under the single-dataset setting, our BRL consistently achieves superior performance across different benchmarks and backbone scales. Compared with existing PEFT methods, BRL demonstrates substantial gains on both oIoU and mIoU metrics.
blocks.zh: 在单一数据集设置下,我们的BRL在不同的基准和主干尺度上一贯取得优异的业绩. 与现有的PEFT方法相比,BRL显示在OIOU和mIOU两个度量标准上都取得了显著进展。

blocks.en: Specifically, using the DINOv2-B [ 35 ] backbone, BRL-B surpasses DETRIS-B [ 37 ] by +2.5%/+1.5%/+2.2% oIoU on RefCOCO val/testA/testB and by +2.9%/+2.6%/+2.3% mIoU, respectively. Similar improvements are consistently observed on RefCOCO+, where BRL-B achieves 73.7% oIoU and 76.7% mIoU on the testA split. On the more challenging RefCOCOg benchmark, BRL-B also achieves clear advantages over previous PEFT approaches, validating the effectiveness of reciprocal multimodal adaptation for long and complex referring expressions. Impressively, BRL-B outperforms DETRIS-L across all benchmarks except the RefCOCO+ testB split, highlighting the efficacy of our multimodal reciprocal learning. When equipped with the larger DINOv2-L backbone, BRL-L consistently improves all benchmarks across RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg datasets over DETRIS-L. In particular, BRL with DINOv3-L [ 36 ] reaches 79.3%, 81.3%, and 75.4% oIoU on the RefCOCO val, testA, and testB splits, respectively, while simultaneously obtaining 81.1%, 82.4%, and 77.7% mIoU, setting new SOTA records.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,使用DINov2-B[35]骨干,BRL-B在RefCOCO val/testA/测试上比DETRIS-B[37]多出+2.5%/+1.5%/+2.2%oOU B和以+2.9%/+2.6%/+2.3% mIoU分别表示. 在RefCOCO+中也持续观察到类似的改进,BRL-B在测试中达到73.7% oOU和76.7% mIOU 一分两分. 在更具挑战性的RefCOCOg基准上,BRL-B也比以往的PEFT方法取得了明显的优势,验证了对等的多式联运适应对长而复杂的提法的有效性。 令人印象深刻的是,BRL-B在除RefCOCO+测试之外的所有基准中都超过了DETRIS-L B拆分,突出我们多式联运对等学习的效果. 在装备更大的DINov2-L主干时,BRL-L在DETRIS-L上不断改进整个RefCOCO,RefCOCO+和RefCOCOCOg数据集的所有基准. 特别是,DINov3-L[36]的BRL在RefCOCO val, testA和 testB上分别达到79.3%,81.3%和75.4% oOU,同时获得81.1%,82.4%和77.7% mIoU,建立了新的SOTA记录.

blocks.en: Moreover, BRL also achieves superior performance compared with recent fully fine-tuning RIS methods. Despite updating only lightweight reciprocal adapters, BRL with DINOv3-L achieves better results than fully fine-tuning methods such as CMANet [ 67 ] and CMIRNet [ 68 ] . Notably, BRL-L under the common setting already surpasses the traditional full fine-tuning method CMIRNet-L trained under the mixed setting on RefCOCO. This observation demonstrates the remarkable efficiency of BRL, which achieves stronger performance using less training data and substantially lower optimization cost. Compared with large-scale MLLM-based models such as SegLLM [ 6 ] and POPEN [ 7 ] , BRL achieves competitive performance while avoiding expensive multimodal instruction tuning and massive training data. These results demonstrate that effective bidirectional reciprocal adaptation can provide strong multimodal alignment without relying on heavy end-to-end optimization.
blocks.zh: 此外,比起最近的完全微调的RIS方法,BRL还实现了优异的性能. 尽管仅更新轻量级对等适配器,但使用DINOv3-L的BRL比完全微调方法,如CMANet[67]和CMIRNet[68],效果更好. 值得注意的是,在共同环境下的BRL-L已经超过了传统的CMIRNet-L全微调法,在RefCOCO的混合环境下进行了培训。 这一观察表明,BRL效率显著,使用较少的培训数据和大幅度降低优化成本,提高了业绩。 与SegLLM[6]和POPEN[7]等大型基于MLLM的模型相比,BRL在避免昂贵的多式联运指令调制和大规模培训数据的同时实现了竞争性性能. 这些结果表明,有效的双向对等适应可以提供强有力的多式联运协调,而不必依赖沉重的端到端优化。

blocks.en: IV-C 2 Comparison Under the Mixed Setting
blocks.zh: IV-C 2 混合设置下的比较

blocks.en: Under the mixed-dataset setting, our BRL exhibits stronger generalization capability. Benefiting from reciprocal multimodal learning across diverse referring distributions, BRL consistently outperforms existing methods on all benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 在混合数据集的设置下,我们的BRL显示出更强的概括能力. 通过在各种参考分布中相互学习多种模式,BRL始终超越所有基准的现有方法。

blocks.en: Specifically, BRL with DINOv3-B [ 36 ] achieves 81.7%, 78.1%, and 75.8% oIoU on RefCOCO val, RefCOCO+ testA, and RefCOCOg val(u), respectively, outperforming previous PEFT methods by clear margins. In terms of mIoU, BRL-B further achieves 82.4%, 80.4%, and 77.3% on the corresponding benchmarks, validating the robustness of the proposed reciprocal adaptation mechanism. More importantly, BRL with DINOv2-B already surpasses DETRIS [ 37 ] equipped with the stronger DINOv2-L backbone on the RefCOCO benchmark under both oIoU and mIoU metrics. For example, BRL-B achieves 81.2%/83.5%/78.2% oIoU while DETRIS-L gets 80.7%/82.2%/77.9% oIoU on the RefCOCO val/testA/testB splits, clearly exceeding the latter despite using a smaller backbone. This further verifies the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed bidirectional reciprocal learning scheme.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,DINov3-B[36]的BRL在RefCOCO val、RefCOCO+测试A和RefCOCOg val(u)上分别取得了81.7%、78.1%和75.8%的OIOU的成绩,比以往的PEFT方法有明显的差值。 在mIoU方面,BRL-B在相应的基准上进一步达到了82.4%,80.4%和77.3%,证明了拟议的对等适应机制的稳健性. 更重要的是,DINov2-B的BRL已经超过了DETRIS[37],在OIOU和mIOU的度量标准下,装备了RefCOCO基准上更强大的DINov2-L骨干. 例如,BRL-B实现 81.2 %/83.5%/78.2% OIOU,而DETRIS-L获得 在RefCOCO val/testA/testB上的OIOU比例为80.7%/82.2%/77.9%,尽管使用了较小的骨干,但明显超过了后者。 这进一步验证拟议的双向对等学习计划的有效性和可扩展性。

blocks.en: In addition, BRL with DINOv3-L establishes new state-of-the-art PEFT performance across almost all datasets and metrics. Specifically, it achieves 82.4%, 84.6%, and 79.8% oIoU on RefCOCO val/testA/testB, together with 83.5%, 85.0%, and 81.0% mIoU. Compared with DETRIS-L under the same setting, BRL-L consistently improves both localization accuracy and segmentation quality across all RIS benchmarks. Moreover, BRL also surpasses all fully fine-tuning methods, despite requiring significantly fewer trainable parameters and computational overhead.
blocks.zh: 此外,使用DINOv3-L的BRL在几乎所有数据集和度量衡上建立了新的最先进的PEFT性能. 具体地说,在RefCOCO val/testA/testB上实现了82.4%、84.6%和79.8%的oIoU,加上83.5%、85.0%和81.0%的mIoU。 与同一环境下的DETRIS-L相比,BRL-L在所有RIS基准中不断提高定位精度和分区质量。 此外,BRL还超越了所有完全微调的方法,尽管对可训练参数和计算间接费用的要求要少得多。

blocks.en: Overall, the experimental results demonstrate that BRL achieves highly effective multimodal adaptation under frozen foundation backbones. By jointly modeling token-level reciprocal interaction and channel-level reciprocal modulation, the proposed framework establishes stronger bidirectional vision-language alignment, leading to consistent improvements across different datasets, metrics, and backbone scales.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,实验结果表明,BRL在冻结的基础骨干下实现了高效的多式联运改造. 拟议的框架通过共同模拟象征性的对等互动和信道的对等调制,建立了更强有力的双向愿景语言一致性,导致不同数据集、指标和主干尺度的一致改进。

blocks.zh: IV-D 阅读研究

blocks.en: We conduct extensive ablation studies on RefCOCO to validate the effectiveness of our BRL. Unless otherwise specified, all experiments are performed using DINOv3 [ 36 ] with CLIP [ 29 ] text encoder under the common setting. In addition, we further investigate the compatibility and robustness of BRL across different vision foundation models (VFMs) [ 79 , 80 , 81 , 35 ] with varying architectures and model scales.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了广泛的研究,以验证我们的BRL的有效性。 除非另有说明,所有实验均使用通用设置下的CLIP [29]文本编码器进行DINOv3[36]. 此外,我们进一步调查不同愿景基础模型[79、80、81、35]不同结构和模型尺度的BRL兼容性和稳健性。

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness of BRL, we first compare it with representative PEFT methods [ 48 , 49 , 31 , 37 ] . As reported in Tab. III , BRL consistently achieves the best performance while maintaining extremely low tunable costs.
blocks.zh: 为了全面评估BRL的有效性,我们首先将其与具有代表性的PEFT方法[48、49、31、37]进行比较。 如塔布所报. 三,BRL在保持极低的金枪鱼可捕成本的同时,一贯取得最佳业绩.

blocks.en: Under the setting of using DINOv3-B, BRL achieves 77.0%/80.0%/74.9% oIoU and 79.3%/81.4%/77.1% mIoU on the RefCOCO val/testA/testB splits, surpassing previous PEFT methods by large margins across all benchmarks. In particular, BRL improves DETRIS [ 37 ] by +1.7%, +2.0%, and +2.8% oIoU on the three splits, respectively, while requiring only 1.5M trainable parameters and 1.4G tunable FLOPs. The impressive results indicate that reciprocal bidirectional interaction is substantially more effective than unidirectional adaptation. It is also worth noting that directly applying full fine-tuning (FFT) to VFMs results in severe performance degradation. Specifically, FFT only achieves 65.7 oIoU and 69.9 mIoU on RefCOCO val, which is dramatically lower than both the fix encoder and PEFT-based adaptation. Similar trends can also be observed under the DINOv3-L backbone. This suggests that large-scale foundation models with strong pre-trained knowledge are highly sensitive to full-parameter optimization, making them prone to catastrophic forgetting. In contrast, PEFT methods preserve the majority of parameters and only optimize a small number of lightweight modules, thereby achieving efficiency. Among them, BRL further achieves superior performance by introducing reciprocal bidirectional adaptation, enabling efficient task-specific learning while maximally preserving the strong prior knowledge of frozen vision and language foundation models.
blocks.zh: 在使用DINOv3-B的设置下,BRL实现 77.0%/8.0%/74.9% OIOU和79.3%/81.4%/77.1% mIOU在参考COCO val/testA/测试中 B拆分,比以往的PEFT方法在所有基准中相差很大. 特别是BRL将DETRIS[37]在三块板块上分别改进+1.7%,+2.0%,+2.8% oIOU,同时只需要1.5M可训练参数和1.4G可金枪鱼FLOP. 令人印象深刻的结果表明,对等双向互动比单向适应有效得多。 还值得指出的是,直接对VFM进行全面的微调(FFT)会导致性能严重退化. 具体而言,FFT在RefCOCO val上只实现了65.7 oIoU和69.9 mIoU,这大大低于固定编码器和基于PEFT的适应。 在DINOv3-L骨干下也可以观察到类似的趋势. 这表明,具有很强的预训知识的大规模基础模型对全参数优化高度敏感,使其容易发生灾难性的遗忘. 相比之下,PEFT方法保存了大多数参数,只优化了少量轻量级模块,从而实现了效率. 其中,BRL通过引入对等双向调整,实现高效的任务特异性学习,同时最大限度地保持对冷冻视野和语言基础模型的强先知识,进一步实现优异性能.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 4 , existing PEFT methods often suffer from incomplete object localization or distracted attention regions due to insufficient cross-modal interaction. By contrast, BRL produces substantially more accurate and semantically consistent segmentation results, especially for challenging scenarios involving ambiguous expressions, small objects, and complex backgrounds. This improvement mainly benefits from the cooperative design of reciprocal token interaction and reciprocal channel modulation, which jointly enhance fine-grained spatial grounding and global semantic consistency.
blocks.zh: 如图4所示,由于跨模式互动不足,现有的PEFT方法往往受到对象定位不全或注意力分散区域的影响。 相比之下,BRL产生的分解结果要大得多的准确和精细一致,特别是对于涉及模棱两可的表达、小物体和复杂背景的具有挑战性的情景。 这种改进主要得益于合作设计对等符号相互作用和对等信道调制,这些办法共同增强了精细的空间定位和全球语义一致性。

blocks.en: Starting from the frozen baseline without any reciprocal adaptation modules, the model achieves 74.0%/76.5%/70.2% oIoU and 75.8%/77.8%/72.6% mIoU on the RefCOCO val/testA/testB splits, respectively. After introducing the RAA module, the performance is consistently improved by +1.9%/+2.1%/+3.0% oIoU and +2.4%/+2.5%/+2.9% mIoU across the three splits. These gains demonstrate that reciprocal token-level interaction effectively enhances fine-grained cross-modal correspondence learning by establishing bidirectional spatial alignment between visual and linguistic tokens.

blocks.en: Similarly, equipping the model solely with the RGA module also yields notable improvements over the baseline, bringing gains of +1.3%/+2.3%/+2.7% oIoU and +2.2%/+2.3%/+2.8% mIoU, respectively. Compared with RAA, RGA introduces slightly fewer parameters and FLOPs while still producing strong improvements, indicating that channel-level reciprocal modulation plays an important role in enhancing global semantic consistency and adaptive feature selection.
blocks.zh: 同样,仅为模型配备RGA模块也比基线有显著的改善,分别带来+1.3%/+2.3%/+2.3%/+2.7%的OIOU和+2.2%/+2.3%/+2.8%的mIOU的增益。 与RAA相比,RGA引入的参数和FLOP稍少,同时仍然产生强烈的改进,表明信道级对等调制在增强全球语义一致性和适应性特征选择方面发挥了重要作用.

blocks.en: When RAA and RGA are jointly employed, BRL achieves the best overall performance, improving the frozen model by +3.0%/+3.5%/+4.7% oIoU and +3.5%/+3.6%/+4.5% mIoU, respectively. The greater gains demonstrate strong complementarity between reciprocal token interaction and reciprocal channel regulation. Moreover, despite only introducing 1.5M trainable parameters and 1.4G tunable FLOPs, our BRL is capable of making remarkable performance, further demonstrating the efficiency of the proposed reciprocal adaptation.
blocks.zh: 在RAA和RGA联合就业时,BRL取得了最佳的整体性能,将冷冻模型分别提高了+3.0%/+3.5%/+4.7% oIoU和+3.5%/+3.6%/+4.5% mIoU. 收益的增加表明,对等象征性互动和对等渠道监管之间有很强的互补性。 此外,尽管仅采用了1.5M型可训练参数和1.4G型可金枪鱼的FLOP,但我们的BRL能够取得显著的性能,进一步表明拟议对等适应的效率。

blocks.en: IV-D 3 Effect of Hyperparameter Settings
blocks.zh: 超参数设置的效果

blocks.en: We further conduct detailed studies on several important hyperparameters of BRL, including the training epochs, residual scaling factor α \alpha , adapter insertion layers, and adapter bottleneck dimension d d .
blocks.zh: 我们还对BRL的几个重要的超参数进行详细研究,包括培训时段、剩余缩放系数α-α、适配器插入层和适配器瓶颈维度d。

blocks.en: We first investigate the influence of training epochs. As illustrated in Fig. 6 . a , the performance improves steadily with longer training and gradually saturates around 50 epochs. Notably, BRL already achieves 76.2%/78.5%/72.7% oIoU and 78.2%/79.9%/74.8% mIoU after only 12 epochs, which already surpasses most existing PEFT methods trained with substantially longer schedules, indicating the fast convergence and high optimization efficiency of our BRL. Increasing the training epochs to 50 further improves the performance to 77.0%/80.0%/74.9% oIoU and 79.3%/81.4%/77.1% mIoU. Although training for 100 epochs slightly improves the validation results, the test performance begins to fluctuate, indicating potential overfitting. Therefore, we adopt 50 epochs as the default setting to achieve a favorable balance between performance and computational cost.
blocks.zh: 我们首先调查训练时代的影响。 如图6a所示,随着培训时间延长,业绩稳步改善,50个世纪左右逐渐饱和。 值得注意的是,BRL已经实现了 76.2%/78.5%/72.7% OIOU和78.2%/79.9%/79.8% mIOU仅经过12个纪元之后,已经超过了大多数经过更长时间培训的现有PEFT方法,这表明我们BRL的快速趋同和高优化效率. 将培训时间提高到50个,使成绩进一步提高到77.0%/80.0%/74.9%oIoU和79.3%/81.4%。 虽然对100个时代的培训略微改善了验证结果,但测试性能开始波动,表明潜在的过度适应. 因此,我们采用50个时代作为默认设置,以便在性能和计算成本之间实现有利的平衡。

blocks.en: We further analyze the influence of α \alpha , which controls the strength of reciprocal adaptation. As shown in Fig. 6 . b , BRL remains relatively stable across different settings, demonstrating good robustness. Moderate scaling factors generally perform better, while overly large values may disturb the frozen representations. Specifically, α = 0.2 \alpha=0.2 achieves the best overall performance with 77.0%/80.0%/74.9% oIoU and 79.3%/81.4%/77.1% mIoU. In contrast, α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 causes noticeable performance degradation, especially on the testB split. We also evaluate a learnable scaling strategy, which achieves competitive but not superior results compared with fixed moderate values.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步分析α-α的影响,它控制了相互适应的力量。 如图6.b所示,不同环境的BRL保持相对稳定,显示出良好的稳健性。 适度的缩放因子一般表现较好,而过高的值可能会扰乱被冻结的表示。 具体来说,α=0.2\alpha=0.2 实现了最佳的整体业绩,分别为77.0%/80.0%/74.9% oIoU和79.3%/81.4%/77.1% mIoU. 相比之下,α=1.0\α=1.0导致显著性能退化,特别是在测试B分裂时. 我们还评价一项可学习的推广战略,与固定的中度价值观相比,该战略取得了有竞争力但并非优越的成果。

blocks.en: To explore where reciprocal adaptation is most effective, we insert the RAA and RGA modules individually into different transformer layers. As illustrated in Fig. 6 . c , BRL achieves stable improvements across nearly all insertion positions, demonstrating strong robustness. Nevertheless, middle and deeper transformer layers generally produce better performance than shallow layers, since deeper layers contain richer semantic representations and stronger cross-modal alignment capability. These results indicate that reciprocal multimodal adaptation is particularly effective when applied to semantically expressive transformer stages.
blocks.zh: 为了探索在哪些方面相互适应最为有效,我们将RAA和RGA模块单独插入不同的变压器层. 如图6c所示,BRL在几乎所有的插入位置上都取得了稳定的改进,显示出强大的稳健性。 尽管如此,中深变压器层一般比浅层产生更好的性能,因为更深层包含更丰富的语义表达和更强的跨模式对接能力. 这些结果表明,对等的多式联运适应在适用于显式变压器阶段时特别有效。

blocks.en: Finally, we study the impact of the adapter hidden dimension d d , which controls the compression ratio of reciprocal adaptation. As reported in Tab. V , increasing d d from 16 to 128 consistently improves the segmentation performance, indicating stronger reciprocal representation capacity. In particular, BRL achieves the best overall performance with 77.5%/80.2%/74.7% oIoU and 79.6%/81.6%/77.4% mIoU at d = 128 d=128 . However, further increasing d d to 256 yields performance degradation while significantly increasing parameters and FLOPs. This suggests that excessively large adapter dimensions may introduce redundancy and weaken parameter efficiency. Considering both performance and efficiency, we adopt d = 64 d=64 as the default setting, which provides a favorable trade-off between reciprocal representation capability and computational overhead.

blocks.en: IV-D 4 Compatibility with Different VFMs
blocks.zh: IV-D 4 与不同的VFM兼容性

blocks.en: To further validate the generalization capability of BRL, we combine our method with various VFMs of different architectures and scales under both the common and the mixed settings. The quantitative results are reported in Tab. VI and Tab. VII , and qualitative comparisons under the mixed setting are illustrated in Fig. 7 .

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. VI , BRL consistently improves the performance across different VFMs, including DINO [ 79 ] , MAE [ 80 ] , EVA2 [ 81 ] , DINOv2 [ 35 ] , and DINOv3 [ 36 ] . Earlier works such as DINO and MAE exhibit relatively limited performance, while more recent large-scale representation learning models achieve substantially better results. In particular, DINOv3 demonstrates the strongest overall performance under almost all scales. For example, DINOv3-B achieves 77.0%/80.0%/74.9% oIoU and 79.3%/81.4%/77.1% mIoU on RefCOCO val/testA/testB, respectively, outperforming DINOv2-B by +1.3% mIoU testB while using fewer FLOPs. Similar trends are also observed under large-scale settings, where DINOv3-H+ reaches the best overall performance with 80.0%/82.2%/76.3% oIoU and 82.0%/83.4%/78.5% mIoU while only introducing 2.0M parameters (0.2% of the VFM).

VI, BRL在不同的VFM中不断改进性能,包括DINO [79],MAE [80],EVA2 [81],DINov2 [35],和DINov3 [36]. 早先的作品,如DINO和MAE,表现相对有限,而更近期的大规模代表性学习模式则取得了显著更好的成果. 特别是,DINOv3显示了几乎所有比额表下最强的总体业绩。 例如,DINOv3-B实现 在参考COCO val/testA/testB中,分别有77.0%/80.0%/74.9%OIOU和79.3%/81.4%/77.1%mIOU在DINov2-B中表现优于1.3%,mIOU测试 B同时使用更少的FLOP. 在大规模环境下也观察到类似的趋势,DINov3-H+达到了最佳的整体性能,达到80.0%/82.2%/76.3%oIoU和82.0%/83.4%/78.5%mIoU,而仅采用了2.0M参数(VFM的0.2%)。

blocks.en: The mixed benchmark results in Tab. VII further demonstrate the scalability of BRL under larger and more diverse training distributions. As the VFM capacity increases, the segmentation performance improves consistently. Among them, BRL combined with DINOv3-H+ establishes the best overall performance on most RefCOCO and RefCOCOg benchmarks, achieving 83.5%/85.3%/80.4% oIoU and 84.2%/85.6%/81.9% mIoU on RefCOCO val/testA/testB, respectively. Meanwhile, DINOv2-G and EVA2-L also exhibit strong competitiveness on RefCOCOg and RefCOCO+, respectively, indicating that different VFMs may possess different domain preferences.
blocks.zh: 混合基准的结果是Tab。 七进一步表明,在更大和更多样化的培训分配下,BRL是可扩展的。 随着VFM容量的提高,分化性能持续改善. 其中,BRL与DINov3-H+结合,为大多数RefCOCO和RefCOCOg基准确定了最佳的总体业绩,在RefCOCO val/testA/testB上分别实现了83.5%/85.3%/80.4% oIoU和84.2%/85.6%/81.9% mIoU. 同时,DINOv2-G和EVA2-L在RefCOCOg和RefCOCO+上也分别表现出强大的竞争力,表明不同的VFM可能拥有不同的域名偏好.

blocks.en: Overall, these experiments demonstrate that the proposed BRL is highly compatible with diverse VFMs and can consistently transfer the representation advantages of large-scale pretrained visual encoders into referring image segmentation. Moreover, the performance improvements become increasingly significant as the model scale grows, highlighting the strong scalability of BRL in the large foundation model era.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些实验表明,拟议的BRL与多种VFM高度兼容,能够持续地将大规模预先训练的视觉编码器的表示优势转移到参考图像分割. 此外,随着模型规模的扩大,性能的提高也变得越来越重要,凸显了BRL在大型基础模型时代的强烈可扩展性.

blocks.en: IV-D 5 Failure Cases
blocks.zh: 4-D 5 失败案件

blocks.en: To better understand the limitations of BRL, we further visualize several representative failure cases in Fig. 8 . Generally, most mistakes can be categorized into four types: (1) Complex relational reasoning, where the referring expression contains multi-object interactions, making accurate localization difficult; (2) Severe object occlusion, where the target is heavily covered; (3) Incorrect textual description, where the expression contains inaccurate attributes, resulting in misleading the cross-modal alignment process; (4) Annotation inconsistency, where the provided segmentation mask does not strictly correspond to the actual instance.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地了解BRL的局限性,我们在图8中进一步描绘了几个有代表性的故障案例. 一般来说,大多数错误可以分为四类: (1)复杂的关系推理,指代表达包含多对象相互作用,使得准确的本地化变得困难;(2)严重物体隐匿,目标被大量覆盖;(3)文字描述不正确,表示包含不准确的属性,导致对跨模式对齐过程的误导;(4)注释不一致,所提供分割面罩不严格符合实际实例.

blocks.en: Unfortunately, we observe that these challenging samples often lead to consistently incorrect predictions across different model scales. Even when stronger VFMs are adopted, the model still fails rather than showing gradual improvements. This suggests that such errors mainly stem from the intrinsic difficulty of multimodal reasoning and dataset quality issues, instead of insufficient model capacity alone. These observations indicate that future RIS research may require not only stronger foundation models, but also more reliable annotations and enhanced reasoning mechanisms for complex vision-language understanding.
blocks.zh: 不幸的是,我们发现这些具有挑战性的样本往往导致不同模型尺度的预测始终不正确。 即使采用了更强的VFM,该模型仍然失败,而不是表现出逐渐的改进. 这表明,这种错误主要源于多式联运推理和数据集质量问题的内在困难,而不只是模型能力不足。 这些观察表明,未来的RIS研究可能不仅需要更强大的基础模型,还需要更可靠的说明和增强的推理机制,以便复杂的视觉语言理解.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose Bidirectional Reciprocal Learning (BRL), a novel parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) framework for referring image segmentation. Different from existing PEFT methods that mainly focus on adapting visual representations independently, BRL explicitly models bidirectional vision-language interactions through the proposed Reciprocal Attention Adapter (RAA) and Reciprocal Gate Adapter (RGA). Specifically, RAA performs reciprocal cross-modal attention between visual and linguistic features to establish fine-grained semantic correspondence, while RGA further conducts reciprocal global gating to adaptively enhance modality-aware feature responses. By integrating both modules into the transformer architecture through residual adaptation, BRL can effectively transfer multimodal knowledge while maintaining extremely low trainable cost.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出双向对等学习(BRL),这是一种新颖的参数效率微调(PEFT)框架,用于参考图像分割. 不同于主要侧重于独立调整视觉表现的现有PEFT方法,BRL通过拟议的对等注意适应器(RAA)和对等门适应器(RGA),明确模拟双向视觉语言交互. 具体而言,RAA在视觉和语言特征之间进行对等的跨模式关注,以建立精细的语义对应,而RGA则进一步进行对等的全球配对,以适应性地增强模式意识特征响应. 通过剩余改造将两个模块整合到变压器架构中,BRL可以有效传输多式联运知识,同时保持极低的可培训成本.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg under both common and mixed benchmark settings demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method. BRL consistently outperforms existing PEFT methods by a clear margin on both oIoU and mIoU metrics, and even surpasses recent multimodal large language models despite requiring only a tiny fraction of trainable parameters. Notably, BRL equipped with DINOv3-L already exceeds the performance of some full fine-tuning methods trained under the mixed setting, demonstrating remarkably high adaptation efficiency with substantially lower training data and computational cost. Moreover, BRL exhibits excellent compatibility and scalability across various vision foundation models, including DINO, MAE, EVA2, DINOv2, and DINOv3, and establishes new state-of-the-art performance with large-scale pretrained encoders.
blocks.zh: 在通用和混合基准环境下对RefCOCOCO、RefCOCO+和RefCOCOg进行的广泛实验表明拟议方法的优越性。 BRL在OIOU和mIOU两个度量标准上都以明显的比值超过现有的PEFT方法,甚至超过了最近的多式联运大语言模型,尽管只需要一小部分可训练参数。 值得注意的是,装有DINOv3-L的BRL已经超过了在混合环境下培训的一些全面微调方法的性能,表明适应效率非常高,培训数据和计算成本大大降低。 此外,BRL在各种视觉基础模型中表现出极佳的兼容性和可伸缩性,包括DINO,MAE,EVA2,DINov2和DINov3,并用大规模预先训练的编码器建立了新的最新性能.

blocks.en: Overall, the proposed BRL provides a scalable and highly efficient solution for multimodal adaptation in referring image segmentation. We hope this work can offer useful insights for future research on parameter-efficient multimodal learning and encourage further exploration of efficient adaptation strategies for large vision-language foundation models.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,拟议的BRL为在提及图像分割时采用多式联运提供了可扩展和高效的解决办法。 我们希望这项工作能够为今后对参数效率高的多式联运学习的研究提供有益的见解,并鼓励进一步探索大型愿景语言基础模型的高效适应战略。
